[Source coding](source-coding.qmd) shows that the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) of a source is the least average length of a code for it,
up to one [bit](entropy.qmd#def-bit).
This page asks which codes a decoder can read one codeword at a time,
and how long such a code must be.
